purpose: Record the persistence and continuity posture that passes MVP Gate 10 for the selected Skills MVP closeout without treating chat history, private memory, or one machine as the only recovery path.
principles: Repository truth beats chat memory for continuation.
A lane must be resumable after context loss, environment change, agent switch, or interrupted automation.
Private overlays remain private, but public-safe recovery anchors should explain how the system resumes.
Continuation surfaces are derived anchors, not release authority.
No single private machine, assistant thread, or memory store should be the only way to recover the MVP state.

continuity_scenarios.meaning: A new thread or maintainer can recover current state without replaying the entire conversation.
A fresh machine or runtime can identify which repositories, scripts, and public-safe projections matter.
Codex, Claude, another agent, or a human can understand the same repository map and authority boundaries.
A partially completed MVP batch can be resumed from status, evidence, and next-required-proof records.
Private source and public projection pairs remain traceable after split, rename, or declassification updates.
Failed validation, generation, sync, or publication can be diagnosed from declared commands and evidence surfaces.
